---
title: "Python Labs"
---

The computer labs are designed for independent study.  Each lab should include enough background explanation before the programming begins, followed by guided code, experiments, interpretation questions, and short exercises.

## Lab design principles

- Begin with the mathematical idea before importing libraries.
- Use small corpora before using real datasets.
- Make every array shape explicit.
- Include interpretation questions after each experiment.
- Keep code friendly for Google Colab.
- Avoid notebook-only LaTeX commands that render poorly in Colab.
